title: Soup at Camp
lines: A group of kids made soup at camp.
Meg and Sam had a big black pot.
Mom sat by them at the camp table.
Sam threw in beans, corn and nuts.
Tom went to get a jug of juice.
He came back and threw it all in.
"Why is my soup blue?" said Meg.
Sam had a good look in the jug.
It was not juice. It was blue glue.
The group had to start a new pot.
This time Meg read the jug first.
She let Tom mix it with a spoon.
That soup was good. They ate it all up.

questions.ask: What made the soup turn blue?
questions.listenFor: Blue glue that Tom threw in. Line ten says it.

questions.ask: What did Tom think he was putting in?
questions.listenFor: Juice. Line five says he went to get a jug of juice.

questions.ask: How could the kids keep this from happening again? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any sensible answer - read the jug, keep glue out of the camp pot. Listen for the reason.
